description: Skill routing evaluation dataset for edge-ai-libraries repository skills. Used with the skill-creator skill for benchmarking skill trigger accuracy.

skills.name: security
skills.description: On-demand security review skill for Dockerfiles, Compose, Helm, auth/authz, input validation, dependency changes, and CVE-related work.
trigger_prompts: I updated the Dockerfile for the audio-analyzer microservice to use python:3.12-slim, please review it for security issues.
Our model-registry service has a new OAuth2 authentication endpoint. Can you review the code for security vulnerabilities?
I'm upgrading the Python dependencies in time-series-analytics, please check for CVEs in the lockfile.
Review my Helm chart for the dlstreamer-pipeline-server service security context settings.
I'm adding input validation to the VLM serving REST API endpoint, please review for injection risks.
Check if there are any privilege escalation risks in the docker-compose.yml for the semantic-search-agent.
We're adding token-based auth to the document-ingestion service, can you do a security review?
The multimodal-embedding-serving Dockerfile now runs as root. Is that a security problem?
I need a security review of the new file upload handler in the visual-data-preparation microservice.
Bump the base image in our Dockerfile and review the resulting change for security issues.
Review the new deserialization logic added to the vector-retriever service.
Can you check the CI workflow for the model-download service for any supply chain security risks?

Add a new REST endpoint to the model-registry for listing model versions.
